subject: ADR-192: HTTP -- the third transport and the first one anything else can reach, with the official MCP SDK driving a science page through it and the thread defect that connection found
body: TWO TRANSPORTS, AND BOTH ARE SPOKEN TO ONLY BY THE PROCESS THAT LAUNCHED THEM. tools/harness_http.py serves the same gateway over streamable HTTP -- POST /mcp, an SSE stream on GET, DELETE to end the session -- and the whole of it that is not HTTP is one import, `from harness_mcp import Server`; the suite holds that the HTTP layer names none of the four operations. A socket owes three things a pipe does not and all three are here: its own switch (CSRBT_HARNESS_HTTP), a loopback bind that takes an explicit variable to leave, and an Origin check on the parsed hostname so http://127.0.0.1.evil.example is refused. One session: a second initialize is 409, an unknown id 404. THE OFFICIAL MCP PYTHON SDK now drives the collection sheet through it -- seven calls, all answered first time, trace kept in tools/traces/http/ -- and its first request found a defect ninety ADRs had never been able to see: ThreadingHTTPServer answers each request on a new thread and Playwright's sync API may only be driven from the one that created it. Door.pump() hands every gateway call back to the thread that stood the target up. verify_http 65 (new), mutate_http 26/26 (new). No page, no task and no plugin was edited.
